brief:
J Street is positioning itself to establish support for a Jewish ethno-state as a non-negotiable Democratic Party position as internal divisions over Israel policy intensify, Mondoweiss reported. The organization is working to shape the party's stance during a broader struggle over how Democrats approach Israel's future.

The effort reflects deepening fault lines within the Democratic Party regarding Israel policy, with J Street attempting to secure backing for Jewish statehood as a baseline principle even as other voices within the party push for different frameworks.
dek: The contours of the battle over the future of the Democrats' policy toward Israel are starting to take shape, and J Street is trying to cement support for the existence of a Jewish ethno-state as the Party's bottom line.
title: J Street fights to anchor Democratic support for Jewish state
